**No.** The repo's release invariants make `is.waiwai.dictation` permanent. Existing Accessibility grants are keyed to it, so a new identifier would make macOS treat the app as a new one and drop those grants. Sparkle updates also require the bundle ID to match, so existing installs would never receive the update that switches IDs.

If the goal is the name OpenRamble on the launch, change the display name (`CFBundleName` / `CFBundleDisplayName`) and leave the identifier alone. Changing the identifier would be a deliberate reversal of a rule that's written as permanent, so it needs your explicit decision and an update to the rules file. I haven't changed anything.
